entries.title: Knowledge-base scope
entries.answer: The knowledge base covers verified Dubai real estate law, services, procedures, entities, data, calculations and training content.
entries.practical: It is an evidence-backed operational reference; it is not a replacement for an authority portal, signed contract or professional advice.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base owner
entries.jurisdiction: Dubai real estate plus relevant UAE federal rules
entries.use: Use when deciding what content belongs in the library and which layer should hold it.
entries.verification: Original 52-section checklist, V19 source library and store-once architecture.
entries.review: Annual and structural-change review
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Scope must not imply that every transaction has identical requirements.
entries.next: Keep the 52-section baseline unchanged and add coverage through controlled batches.

entries.title: Dubai versus UAE federal jurisdiction
entries.answer: Dubai local legislation and authority procedures operate alongside UAE federal legislation.
entries.practical: Each entry must identify whether the controlling source is federal, Dubai-local, free-zone/special-zone, contractual or provider-specific.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base owner / legal reviewer
entries.jurisdiction: UAE federal and Emirate of Dubai
entries.use: Use before applying any law, tax, AML, banking, residency or local property procedure.
entries.verification: Federal and Dubai legislation plus authority-issued regulations.
entries.review: Quarterly and upon legislation change
entries.audience: Internal and client-facing after approval
entries.disclaimer: Jurisdiction and conflict questions require legal review; free-zone rules may differ.
entries.gap: A consolidated jurisdiction matrix is not yet archived.
entries.next: Create a jurisdiction matrix by topic and authority.

entries.title: Official-source policy
entries.answer: Use original issuing-authority sources as the default evidence.
entries.practical: Store each source once, preserve the original, assign a permanent Source ID, and link it to every supported entry.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base owner
entries.jurisdiction: All covered jurisdictions
entries.use: Use whenever a source is collected, cited, replaced or reused.
entries.verification: V19 Source Register, package indexes, hashes and archive controls.
entries.review: Continuous
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: A webpage capture is not an original authority-issued PDF.
entries.next: Apply the policy to every batch.

entries.title: Primary and secondary source classification
entries.answer: Primary sources are laws, regulations, authority services, official forms, registers and original publications; secondary sources explain or comment on them.
entries.practical: Primary sources control. Secondary sources may help training or interpretation but must be labelled and cannot silently replace official evidence.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base owner
entries.jurisdiction: All covered jurisdictions
entries.use: Use during source intake and conflict resolution.
entries.verification: Source Class field in Master Register V19.
entries.review: Annual
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Developer brochures are primary only for that developerâ€™s own commercial statements, not for law or DLD status.
entries.next: Add source-class validation to future entry batches.

entries.title: Legal source hierarchy
entries.answer: Apply the highest controlling legal instrument, then valid implementing decisions, regulations and official procedures.
entries.practical: A practical hierarchy is federal law where applicable; Dubai law/decree; executive or administrative resolution; authority regulation/circular; service rule; guide/FAQ. Exact precedence depends on subject and wording.
entries.authority: Legal reviewer / knowledge-base owner
entries.jurisdiction: UAE and Dubai
entries.use: Use when sources conflict or a guide appears older than legislation.
entries.verification: Legislation and replacement-chain controls.
entries.review: Upon legal change
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: This hierarchy is an operational research rule, not legal advice; exact conflicts require counsel.
entries.gap: No approved internal legal-escalation matrix.
entries.next: Have legal counsel approve the hierarchy and escalation rule.

entries.title: Source verification process
entries.answer: Verify authority, title, version, date, status, URL, file integrity and relationship to newer sources.
entries.practical: Record filename, Source ID, issuing authority, language, pages, hash, download date, last verification date and exact entry links.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: All sources
entries.use: Use before accepting any source into the permanent library.
entries.verification: V19 register and package validation workflow.
entries.review: Every intake
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: A live page can change; a capture must show capture date and archive disclaimer.
entries.next: Continue checksum and visual verification.

entries.title: Last-verified date
entries.answer: The last-verified date records when the source or entry was most recently checked against its controlling official channel.
entries.practical: It is separate from publication, effective, download and calculation dates.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: All entries and sources
entries.use: Use to judge freshness and schedule review.
entries.verification: Register field and batch verification log.
entries.review: Every verification event
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: A recent verification date does not make an old reference period current.
entries.next: Use ISO date format and update only after a real check.

entries.title: Effective date
entries.answer: The effective date is when a legal instrument or rule begins to apply.
entries.practical: Keep issue, publication, effective, repeal and transitional dates in separate fields.
entries.authority: Legal reviewer / source controller
entries.jurisdiction: Legal and regulatory sources
entries.use: Use before deciding which rule applied to an event or transaction date.
entries.arabic: Arabic text available for many instruments
entries.verification: Replacement and effective-date registers in PKG-019.
entries.review: Upon legal change
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Do not infer effectiveness from webpage upload date.
entries.next: Extract exact effective-date clauses when producing legal entries.

entries.title: Expiry date
entries.answer: Expiry records a stated end date or the date a source ceased to control.
entries.practical: Use â€œnot statedâ€ rather than assuming permanence; distinguish expiry from repeal, supersession and operational replacement.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: All time-limited sources
entries.use: Use for permits, circulars, offers, licences, reports and temporary initiatives.
entries.verification: Date-control policy.
entries.review: At each review
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Absence of an expiry date does not prove that a source remains current.
entries.next: Add expiry field to all future entry templates.

entries.title: Law or circular version
entries.answer: Every version or amendment is preserved and linked; older versions are not overwritten.
entries.practical: Use the current controlling version for operational answers while retaining historical versions for prior-period research.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: Legal, regulatory and procedural sources
entries.use: Use whenever a newer edition, amendment or circular is found.
entries.verification: PKG-019 replacement chains.
entries.review: Continuous
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: An edition date and a legal amendment are different types of change.
entries.next: Keep replacement IDs and reason-for-change fields.

entries.title: Superseded information
entries.answer: Superseded content remains archived but is removed from current operational answers.
entries.practical: Record whether replacement is express legal repeal, formal supersession, amended sequence, newer edition or operational replacement.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: All sources
entries.use: Use when a newer source conflicts with or replaces an earlier one.
entries.verification: PKG-019 replacement and conflict registers.
entries.review: Continuous
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Do not mark a source repealed without evidence.
entries.next: Maintain explicit current/replaced relationships.

entries.title: Archived regulations
entries.answer: Historical regulations and guides are preserved for audit, prior transactions and change analysis.
entries.practical: Archived files must be visibly labelled and must not appear in current procedures without a warning.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: All sources
entries.use: Use for historical legal research and replacement tracing.
entries.verification: PKG-019 archive register.
entries.review: Annual
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Historical market reports remain valid only for their stated period.
entries.next: Continue adding genuine historical originals when located.

entries.title: Emergency regulatory updates
entries.answer: Urgent authority changes must bypass the normal annual cycle and trigger immediate review.
entries.practical: Monitor official notifications, rules pages, circular listings and service updates; freeze affected client guidance until verified.
entries.authority: Compliance owner / knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: All regulated topics
entries.use: Use for emergency circulars, sanctions, public-safety rules, system outages or sudden fee/procedure changes.
entries.verification: Recent official circular channels.
entries.review: Daily for critical feeds; immediate on alert
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: No automated official-alert feed is yet archived.
entries.gap: Formal alert subscriptions and escalation contacts are incomplete.
entries.next: Create an emergency update watchlist and approval workflow.

entries.title: English and Arabic terminology
entries.answer: Maintain linked English and Arabic terms without pretending an internal translation is an official translation.
entries.practical: Where Arabic legislation controls, store the Arabic original and use the official English translation when available; record translation status.
entries.authority: Arabic reviewer / knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: UAE and Dubai
entries.use: Use for all legal terms, forms, services and client explanations.
entries.verification: Bilingual sources already captured in several packages.
entries.review: At each entry update
entries.audience: Internal and client-facing after language review
entries.disclaimer: English and Arabic editions may differ in date or scope.
entries.gap: A complete controlled bilingual glossary is not yet built.
entries.next: Create a bilingual glossary and translation-review log.

entries.title: Glossary linking
entries.answer: Every specialised term should link to one controlled glossary entry instead of being redefined inconsistently.
entries.practical: Definitions may vary by law; record the source-specific definition and a plain-language explanation.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: All sections
entries.use: Use when drafting entries, procedures and training.
entries.verification: Atomic-entry architecture.
entries.review: Continuous
entries.audience: Internal and client-facing
entries.disclaimer: A glossary definition must not override a statutory definition in a specific law.
entries.gap: Glossary entries are not yet produced.
entries.next: Start glossary production in the terminology batch.

entries.title: Related-entry linking
entries.answer: Entries should link to prerequisites, procedures, forms, authorities, entities and calculations.
entries.practical: This avoids repetition and ensures one corrected fact updates every user journey that references it.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: All sections
entries.use: Use whenever an entry is created or amended.
entries.verification: Entry ID and source mapping architecture.
entries.review: Continuous
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Links should be semantic, not merely based on similar words.
entries.next: Add related-entry fields during each batch.

entries.title: User-role classification
entries.answer: Content is classified by the role that may use or act on it.
entries.practical: Roles may include client, broker, brokerage manager, developer, landlord, tenant, owner, investor, compliance, researcher and administrator.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base owner
entries.jurisdiction: Internal governance
entries.use: Use to control access and tailor procedures.
entries.verification: Checklist role-field requirement.
entries.review: Annual
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Role classification does not grant legal authority to perform a regulated activity.
entries.next: Add role tags to all knowledge entries.

entries.title: Client-facing versus internal content
entries.answer: Client-facing content is simplified and approved; internal content may include risks, conflicts, research notes and escalation instructions.
entries.practical: The same evidence may support both layers, but internal notes must not be published automatically.
entries.authority: Content approver
entries.jurisdiction: Internal governance
entries.use: Use before publishing, sending or training from an entry.
entries.verification: Layered knowledge-base architecture.
entries.review: Continuous
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Unverified figures, private notes and legal interpretations remain internal.
entries.next: Add publication status and approval fields.

entries.title: Legal disclaimer
entries.status: Internal policy complete â€” legal approval pending
entries.answer: The knowledge base provides researched information, not transaction-specific legal advice.
entries.practical: Users must verify current law, signed documents, jurisdiction and facts; complex or disputed matters go to qualified legal counsel.
entries.authority: Legal counsel / content approver
entries.jurisdiction: All legal content
entries.use: Use on legal summaries, client guides and training.
entries.verification: Risk-control requirement.
entries.review: Annual and upon legal review
entries.audience: Client-facing
entries.disclaimer: A disclaimer does not cure inaccurate or misleading content.
entries.gap: Final corporate wording has not been approved by counsel.
entries.next: Approve standard English and Arabic legal disclaimers.

entries.title: Financial disclaimer
entries.status: Internal policy complete â€” approval pending
entries.answer: Market data and calculations are informational scenarios, not guaranteed returns or financial advice.
entries.practical: Show assumptions, source dates, fees, financing terms, taxes, vacancy and sensitivity where relevant.
entries.authority: Financial model owner / content approver
entries.jurisdiction: Investment and finance content
entries.use: Use on ROI, yield, mortgage and price comparisons.
entries.verification: Data-governance controls in PKG-018.
entries.review: At each calculation
entries.audience: Client-facing
entries.disclaimer: Past performance and asking prices are not guaranteed outcomes.
entries.gap: Final corporate wording is not approved.
entries.next: Approve financial disclaimer and calculator methodology.

entries.title: Data privacy disclaimer
entries.answer: Personal and confidential data must be minimised, access-controlled and used only for an authorised purpose.
entries.practical: Do not place passports, Emirates IDs, bank details, signed contracts or client contact data in public knowledge outputs.
entries.authority: Data protection owner
entries.jurisdiction: UAE and internal systems
entries.use: Use for source intake, client records, examples, exports and AI processing.
entries.verification: Internal privacy requirement.
entries.review: Annual and incident-triggered
entries.audience: Internal and client-facing
entries.disclaimer: The library must not become a client-document repository.
entries.gap: Current UAE privacy-law source and approved corporate privacy notice are not mapped.
entries.next: Add current privacy legislation and internal retention policy.

entries.title: Content ownership
entries.answer: Original authority and third-party documents retain their ownership; the library controls its indexing, annotations and internal summaries.
entries.practical: Respect licence terms, do not alter official originals, and label internal translations or derived material.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base owner / legal reviewer
entries.jurisdiction: All content
entries.use: Use when storing, sharing or publishing source material.
entries.verification: Open-data licence capture and source provenance fields.
entries.review: Annual
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Possession of a PDF does not grant unlimited redistribution rights.
entries.gap: A complete copyright and permitted-use matrix is not established.
entries.next: Create a source-use and redistribution policy.

entries.title: Approval workflow
entries.answer: Every entry moves through research, source verification, subject review, language review and publication approval.
entries.practical: High-risk legal, AML, tax, mortgage and investment content requires specialist approval before client use.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base owner
entries.jurisdiction: Internal governance
entries.use: Use for every new entry and material amendment.
entries.verification: Batch and register control design.
entries.review: Continuous
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: The researcher should not self-approve high-risk interpretation.
entries.next: Assign named reviewers and service-level targets.

entries.title: Update frequency
entries.answer: Review frequency depends on source volatility and risk.
entries.practical: Live services and critical circulars are checked frequently; laws are change-triggered; historical reports remain fixed to their reference period.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: All entries
entries.use: Use to schedule verification.
entries.verification: V19 control notes and source classes.
entries.review: Risk-based
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: A fixed annual review is insufficient for dynamic services or sanctions.
entries.next: Assign a review frequency to every entry.

entries.title: Change log
entries.answer: Record what changed, why, who approved it, and which sources or entries were affected.
entries.practical: Never silently overwrite controlling content or historical status.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: All entries and controls
entries.use: Use for every material update.
entries.verification: Replacement and delivery logs.
entries.review: Continuous
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Minor formatting changes may be grouped; substantive changes require individual records.
entries.next: Maintain batch and entry-level change logs.

entries.title: Missing-information register
entries.answer: Missing originals, languages, forms, datasets and verification evidence are recorded rather than guessed.
entries.practical: Each gap receives an ID, priority, source URL, reason and next action; resolved rows remain for audit.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: All packages and entries
entries.use: Use whenever evidence is incomplete.
entries.verification: Missing Documents Register V19/V20.
entries.review: Continuous
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: A missing record is not proof that the document does not exist.
entries.next: Continue gap registration and resolution tracking.

entries.title: Conflicting-source register
entries.answer: Conflicting official statements are logged and resolved through source hierarchy, dates and specialist review.
entries.practical: Keep both sources, state the conflict, and do not publish a definitive answer until the controlling source is established.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller / legal reviewer
entries.jurisdiction: All high-risk content
entries.use: Use when official pages, laws, guides or language editions disagree.
entries.verification: PKG-019 source-conflict register.
entries.review: Continuous
entries.audience: Internal
entries.disclaimer: Do not erase the losing or historical source.
entries.next: Maintain conflict IDs and resolution evidence.

entries.title: Official contact directory
entries.answer: Maintain verified contact and escalation channels for each authority, without relying on unverified numbers copied from third parties.
entries.practical: Record official website, service portal, contact centre and escalation channel; verify frequently because office hours and details change.
entries.authority: Knowledge-base controller
entries.jurisdiction: Dubai and UAE authorities
entries.use: Use when directing a user to an authority or escalating a case.
entries.verification: Official contact pages and service portals.
entries.review: Quarterly
entries.audience: Internal and client-facing
entries.disclaimer: Do not store personal employee contacts as official authority channels.
entries.gap: A consolidated verified directory is not yet built.
entries.next: Build the contact directory from Batch 001 authority profiles.

entries.section: Dubai Real Estate Authorities and Organisations
entries.title: Dubai Land Department
entries.answer: Dubaiâ€™s principal authority for real property registration and core real estate services.
entries.practical: DLD records and verifies title, transactions, projects, developers, brokers, leases, valuations and many related services through DLD channels and Dubai REST.
entries.authority: Dubai Land Department
entries.jurisdiction: Emirate of Dubai
entries.use: Use for ownership, registration, Ejari, project/developer verification, brokerage, valuation and official property records.
entries.verification: Official DLD legislation, guides and live services.
entries.review: Quarterly and change-triggered
entries.audience: Internal and client-facing
entries.disclaimer: Only live DLD records confirm current transaction or registration status.
entries.next: Create a consolidated DLD service map.

entries.section: Dubai Real Estate Authorities and Organisations
entries.title: Real Estate Regulatory Agency
entries.answer: RERA is the real estate regulatory agency operating under DLD.
entries.practical: It regulates and supervises key sector activities such as developers, brokers, escrow, jointly owned property management and real estate professional activities within its legal mandate.
entries.authority: Real Estate Regulatory Agency / Dubai Land Department
entries.jurisdiction: Emirate of Dubai
entries.use: Use for regulatory compliance, licensing, broker conduct, developer and jointly owned property matters.
entries.verification: Law No. 4 of 2019 and current DLD/RERA guide.
entries.review: Quarterly and legal-change triggered
entries.audience: Internal and client-facing
entries.disclaimer: The 2007 establishment law is historical; Law No. 4 of 2019 is the controlling replacement identified in the library.
entries.next: Map RERA functions to individual operational entries.

entries.section: Dubai Real Estate Authorities and Organisations
entries.title: Rental Disputes Center
entries.answer: RDC is Dubaiâ€™s specialised forum for rental disputes and specified jointly owned property disputes.
entries.practical: It provides amicable settlement, first instance, appeal, execution and related judicial services within its jurisdiction.
entries.authority: Rental Disputes Center
entries.jurisdiction: Emirate of Dubai, subject to statutory jurisdiction
entries.use: Use for landlordâ€“tenant disputes, rental execution and eligible jointly owned property disputes.
entries.verification: RDC establishing decree and current service captures.
entries.review: Quarterly and legal-change triggered
entries.audience: Internal and client-facing
entries.disclaimer: Not every property dispute falls within RDC jurisdiction; jurisdiction must be checked.
entries.gap: Current consolidated case-service guide remains missing.
entries.next: Link each dispute type to its correct RDC service.

entries.section: Dubai Real Estate Authorities and Organisations
entries.title: Real Estate Registration Trustee Offices
entries.answer: DLD-authorised registration trustee offices process specified property registration transactions.
entries.practical: They act as authorised service channels connected to DLD; they do not replace DLD as registrar or regulator.
entries.authority: Dubai Land Department
entries.jurisdiction: Emirate of Dubai

entries.verification: Official directory capture and DLD investor guide.
entries.review: Monthly
entries.audience: Internal and client-facing
entries.disclaimer: Office list, hours, fees and accepted services can change.
entries.gap: Downloadable current directory remains missing as MISS-003-003.
entries.next: Reverify the live office before appointment.

entries.section: Dubai Real Estate Authorities and Organisations
entries.title: Real Estate Services Trustee Offices
entries.answer: Real estate services trustee offices provide selected DLD services under an agreement and official authorisation.
entries.practical: Their exact service scope depends on the live DLD listing and the office agreement; they are service channels, not independent regulators.
entries.authority: Dubai Land Department
entries.jurisdiction: Emirate of Dubai
entries.use: Use when a DLD service is offered through a services trustee centre.
entries.english: Live official page found â€” archive pending
entries.verification: Live DLD directory confirmed during Batch 001 research.
entries.review: Monthly
entries.audience: Internal and client-facing

entries.next: Capture the directory and scope into PKG-003.

entries.section: Dubai Real Estate Authorities and Organisations

entries.answer: Real estate promotion trustee is a DLD-listed licensed activity requiring DLD agreement/approval.

entries.verification: DLD real estate licensing service lists the activity.
entries.review: Quarterly
entries.audience: Internal

entries.section: Dubai Real Estate Authorities and Organisations

entries.authority: Dubai Municipality
entries.jurisdiction: Dubai Municipality jurisdiction
